items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I left after then with him. We toured all through Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Illinois, Illinois, Iowa, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Michigan.

ctx.x: About what date was that? I mean, or what years? How old were you when you were with Desden? Well, that was around 1928. When did you leave on tour with him? Right away then, after that? Well, I left after then with him.

We toured all through Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Illinois, Illinois, Iowa, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Michigan. And we made, we played Oklahoma also. Played a few dates over in Dakota, South Dakota, across from Sioux City, Iowa.
